{{Short description|Measures of Scottish unemployment}}
{{prose|date=August 2015}}

'''Unemployment in Scotland''' measured by the [[Office for National Statistics]] show unemployment in Scotland at 155,000 (5.6%) as of August 2015.<ref name="UKgovPR Aug2015">{{cite press release |url=https://www.gov.uk/government/news/unemployment-in-scotland-down |title=Unemployment in Scotland down |publisher=UK Government |date=13 August 2015 |access-date=19 June 2016}}</ref>
